title: Types of computer by purpose of application

keywords.def: A computer designed to solve a single problem, e.g. a pocket calculator.
A computer that runs different programs to solve many kinds of problems.

en.text: By purpose, computers are special purpose or general purpose. A special-purpose computer is built for one problem: a pocket calculator, a ticket machine, a traffic-light control system, a public telephone box, a counter. A general-purpose computer runs many different programs to solve many problems; microcomputers, minicomputers and supercomputers are examples. General-purpose computers are more flexible.

screens.title: One job only
screens.ask: A pocket calculator cannot play videos or write letters. Why?
opts: It is built for one job: calculating
screens.after: It is a special-purpose computer, designed for one problem.

screens.title: Two types by purpose
paras: Special purpose computers are designed to solve a single problem. Their parts are adapted to one specific use.
Examples: public telephone box, road traffic control system, ticket machines, pocket calculators, counters.
General purpose computers are designed to solve a variety of problems by running different programs. They are more flexible and versatile.

screens.text: A smartphone can be a calculator, a camera and a map. Which type is it?
screens.why: It runs many programs (apps) for many problems; a calculator app is just one program on a general-purpose computer.
